text:
maria_chu: Morning team — quick preflight for Orbit SDK push tomorrow 10:00 PT. Docs freeze at 09:00 PT. Need owners for sample apps smoke + changelog signoff.

samir: I'm on sample-apps smoke. Will run through web, server, and mobile flows by 08:00 PT. Pull requests to watch: #PR-412, #PR-415.

alex_t: I'll lock the SDK package publish pipeline at 09:20 PT. Please hold final API tweaks until then.

jin-park: Docs updated in staging (landing + migration guide). Link: https://docs.staging.redwood.dev/orbit — can someone sanity-check the migration example? Note: search index rebuild might lag ~15m.

emily: Changelog draft is here: /docs/changelogs/ORBIT-1.5.md — calls out an auth header change. Need one more approval from @alex_t and @samir.

samir: skimmed the changelog, left one wording suggestion inline. overall :thumbsup:.

maria_chu: @devex-bot can you kick off the scheduled smoke matrix (linux/mac/android) once CI queue clears?

devex-bot: scheduled smoke runs on linux/mac/android for 08:10 PT. Will post results to this thread when complete.

devex-bot: smoke run summary: web ✅, server ✅, mobile flaky on login (token refresh). Logs snippet: ```ERR: token exchange 401 at /auth/refresh``` CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/2345

jin-park: mobile flaky looks like token-refresh header name mismatch between SDK and sample app. I'll push a hotfix branch momentarily and add a short PR for quick review.

alex_t: if it's a header rename only we can merge & still publish before 10:00 as long as CI is green by 09:30. @maria_chu what's the rollback window?

maria_chu: rollback window until 11:00 PT. If we see regressions after 10:00 we'll roll back to v1.4.2.

samir: I'll re-run the sample smoke after jin's fix and report back. If green, I'll post a "ready to ship" by 09:45 PT.

emily: tagging platform docs/indexing for priority rebuild of search (FYI).

devex-bot: all checks green at 09:50 PT. Sha: build/2345/status=green. Ready to release.

maria_chu: Thanks all — publishing at 10:00 PT. I'll post release notes + console update after publish.

maria_chu: Post-release followups: please add any manual migration notes to the docs page and ping me if you see telemetry spikes.
